M339 closes metadata-only rename, M340 closes content-bearing save, M341 closes PNG background registration/binding, M343 closes in-memory add-Scene, M345 closes PNG handout registration, M347 closes WAV audio registration, and M349 closes PNG/WebP token registration; these remain operation-specific closures rather than generic Stage 11 acceptance.

The desktop still exposes direct create, save-as, save, rename, asset, migration, recovery, and editor handlers; direct handler presence is producer evidence and does not certify a generalized batch tray or every mutating path.

The project proposal session now covers exact rename, content-save, in-memory add-Scene, background binding, handout, audio, token, and persistent add-Scene boundaries; create and save-as remain ordinary persistence gaps with distinct workspace and source/target identity requirements.

The native store remains merge-only for asset preservation and has no deletion/cleanup authority; recovery, provider, credential, browser, Foundry, and player-password activity remain outside this reconciliation.
Create, save-as, recovery breadth, broader producer-family acceptance, and overall Stage 11 acceptance remain open; all four Stage 11 clauses remain partial.
